userdoc.notice: PvP color-invasion game vault with withdrawal cooldown. V4 changes vs V3:  - Added WITHDRAW_COOLDOWN (5 minutes). After any balance-affecting    activity (deposit, settleMatch, refundMatch), the player must wait    before withdrawing. This prevents the "loser front-runs settlement"    exploit where a loser calls withdraw() before settleMatch lands,    causing settlement to revert and dodging the loss.  - Owner can adjust the cooldown via setCooldown() (capped at 1 hour).  - Emergency withdrawals (owner-triggered) bypass the cooldown for    contract migration scenarios.
